messages.content:
You answer a question about machines at work (law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, company and plant
documents) using ONLY the numbered passages given. Each passage is headed by its document, its place and its rank.

Rules:
- Use only the passages. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- Answer only if a passage states the answer for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the same article
  and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline). A passage about a neighbouring subject does not
  answer the question: then the kind is "unknown" and the value is null. A question about something that happened
  (the date of the last check, whether something is overdue today) is "unknown" unless a passage records that event.
- A passage marked "corrected by the corrigendum" already shows the corrected wording: reason with it. The old
  wording, given in the mark, is no longer valid.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the passages, one by one. A repeal or an
  application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a date is still fully in
  force on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does not yet bind on earlier days.
- When passages of different rank disagree, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's manual,
  then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.) wins over a
  ministerial decree (DM). Say which one wins.
- A row of a table belongs to the thing named in that same row. Read the row of the item asked about, not a
  neighbouring row. When the question itself states a condition ("if it were in regular use", "built in 2017"),
  reason with that condition.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / by which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "how often / for how
  long / within what time" is "duration"; "can / may / is / does / must" is "boolean"; "which / what (several
  things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition is "text" (one short sentence naming every element asked for).
- Point at the evidence: for every passage you rely on, copy word for word the sentence, or the table row, that
  states what you use. Copy exactly, without changing a character; do not join text from two places.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "what the passages say and how it leads to the answer, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y", "P6M", "P45D", "PT1H" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "evidence": [{"passage": <number>, "quote": "<copied exactly from that passage>"}]}

Article 25 Conformity assessment procedures for machinery and related products. 3. Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures: (a) internal production control (module A) set out in Annex VI; (b) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII; (c) conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX; (d) conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X. If a manufacturer applies the internal production control procedure referred to in point (a), it shall design and construct the machinery or related product in accordance with the harmonised standards or common specifications specific to that category of machinery or related product covering all the relevant essential health and safety requirements. Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B, and the machinery or related product was not designed and constructed in accordance with the harmonised standards or common specifications specific to that category of machinery or related product covering all the relevant essential health and safety requirements for that category of machinery or related product, the manufacturer, including a natural or legal person referred to in Article 18, shall apply one of the procedures referred to in points (b), (c) or (d) of this paragraph.

Guida ai servizi di verifica di attrezzature, macchine e impianti di più ampia pratica e interesse Conseguentemente alle prove, viene emessa una certificazione che individua il periodo di ulteriore esercibilità del recipiente sino alla scadenza della successiva revisione periodica (31 dicembre del decimo anno successivo al collaudo). Al ter- mine della procedura di revisione, sono punzonate sulla ghiera le ultime due cifre dell’anno di collaudo, seguite dalla stella RI (Repubblica Italiana). I recipienti costruiti secondo la direttiva TPED sono invece sottoposti, secondo quanto prescritto dalla norma UNI EN 1440, alle seguenti attività di revisione: 1. ispezione visiva esterna; 2. ispezione visiva interna; 3. prova di pressione; 4. controllo delle filettature del collare e della valvola. È prevista la possibilità, per le bombole in acciaio, saldate e ricaricabili, utilizza- te per il trasporto del GPL, di essere esentate dall’obbligo di verifica dello stato interno, la cui deroga, prevista dall’Adr, è contemplata dall’accordo multilaterale M308. La circolazione delle bombole, verificate secondo l’Accordo M308, è limitata esclu- sivamente ai Paesi firmatari (Italia e Francia). Conseguentemente alle prove viene emessa una certificazione (anche cumula- tiva purché le bombole appartengano allo stesso proprietario) con l’indicazione della scadenza della revisione periodica successiva. Vengono punzonati l’identifi- cativo dell’Organismo Notificato e la data del collaudo.
